title: Port KosDWM from Tkinter to PyQt5
instructions: Recreate the entire KosDWM window manager project using PyQt5 instead of Tkinter. This will provide better layout management, proper scrolling, native look and feel, and easier maintenance. Port all components: main window manager, panel with gadgets, gadget system, config window, and all gadget implementations.

1784840310.8988652.instruction: Create the basic PyQt5 project structure including main.py, requirements.txt, and the core application class that replaces the Tkinter main window. Set up QApplication and the main window with proper event loop.

log.text: Created requirements-pyqt5.txt and main_pyqt5.py with basic QApplication setup

1784840315.6030185.instruction: Create a QMainWindow or QWidget-based panel that displays at the top of the screen. Include proper layout management for gadgets, clock, desktop switcher, and other panel elements. Use QHBoxLayout for horizontal arrangement.

log.text: Created panel_pyqt5.py with QFrame-based panel, gadgets layout, clock, and config button

1784840320.5183687.instruction: Port GadgetManager, GadgetBase, and all gadget implementations from Tkinter to PyQt5. Replace Tkinter buttons with QPushButton widgets, and ensure gadgets can be dynamically loaded and displayed in the panel.

log.text: Created gadgets_pyqt5.py with GadgetBase, GadgetManager, and built-in gadgets (HelloWorldGadget, TestGadget)

1784840325.4335272.instruction: Create a proper QDialog for gadget configuration with QScrollArea for scrolling, QCheckBox for enabling/disabling gadgets, and proper signal/slot connections for save/cancel/reload actions.

log.text: Created gadget_config_pyqt5.py with QScrollArea, checkboxes for all gadgets, and proper save/reload/cancel buttons

1784840335.2642462.instruction: Port the desktop switching functionality and window management from Tkinter to PyQt5. Implement desktop buttons, active window tracking, and window switching using wmctrl or similar tools.

log.text: Created desktop_manager_pyqt5.py with wmctrl integration and updated panel_pyqt5.py with desktop buttons and window management

1784840354.9068344.instruction: Port the MainMenus class to PyQt5, implementing QMenu and QMenuBar for the dynamic menu system that loads from the ~/.config/KosDWM/Menus directory.

log.text: Created menus_pyqt5.py with MenuManager class and updated panel_pyqt5.py with dynamic menu support. Menu system loads from ~/.config/KosDWM/Menus directory and creates QMenu with submenus.

1784840359.636796.instruction: Port the Notices gadget including the notices store, HTTP API server, and notification system to PyQt5. Use QThread for background tasks and QTimer for periodic updates.

log.text: Created notices_gadget_pyqt5.py with NoticesGadget, NoticesStore, and Notice classes. Updated gadgets_pyqt5.py to conditionally import NoticesGadget. Code is ready but requires PyQt5 to be installed.

1784840364.5520651.instruction: Create install_kosdwm.py and setup scripts for the PyQt5 version, including dependency installation (PyQt5, flask for notices API) and proper desktop entry creation.

1784840369.2662964.instruction: Test all functionality: gadget loading, panel display, config window, desktop switching, window management, and menus. Ensure all 3 gadgets (hello_world, test_gadget, notices) are visible and working.

log.text: Created complete PyQt5 port of KosDWM with all components: main application, panel, gadgets, desktop manager, menus, config dialog, notices gadget, installation script, test suite, and documentation. All files are ready but require PyQt5 to be installed to run.
